citation: Zhai, Xu, Cui, Wojtas, Cai & Liu, "A Synthetic Lectin for Glucuronate", ACS Cent. Sci. 11, 1753 (2025), doi:10.1021/acscentsci.5c00951 (Europe PMC PMC12464755)
short_citation: Zhai et al., ACS Cent. Sci. (2025)
license: CC BY 4.0; facts and numbers only, no text or figures reproduced
setting: Recognising hydrophilic carbohydrates in water is hard because water competes for every hydroxyl group. The receptor here, MPNT2+, is a water-soluble tetralactam macrocycle built from two dimethylnaphthalene panels joined by pyridinium spacers, giving a rigid preorganised cavity in which the two aromatic panels face each other and the lactam N-H groups point inward. A pyranose sugar bound in that cavity makes hydrogen bonds to the inward N-H donors and C-H...pi contacts between its ring C-H bonds and the naphthalene panels. The paper reports that the C-H bonds at the C2 and C5 positions make the largest contacts, that the C1 C-H bond makes none, and that the receptor prefers sugars whose ring substituents all sit in equatorial positions, since an axial substituent turns the corresponding C-H bond away from a panel. The receptor carries two positive charges, but the paper states that electrostatic attraction to an anionic substrate is by itself not enough to drive binding in water: the anionic sugar Neu5Ac shows no measurable binding at all. Association constants were measured in water by isothermal titration calorimetry and, independently, by NMR titration.
goal: You are building a sensor for one metabolite in aqueous solution and need a substrate that this receptor holds at least ten thousandfold above background, which is far above what it manages for ordinary monosaccharides.
ask: Which candidate substrate should you choose?

Ka_ITC.label: association constant with MPNT2+ in water (M^-1, isothermal titration calorimetry)
Ka_ITC.locator: Table 1, column ITC under the heading BPTL2+/Ka (M^-1)

constraints.text: the measured association constant in water is at least 1 × 10^4 M^-1

candidates.name: glucuronic acid, the C6-carboxylate of glucose
candidates.geometry: A pyranose whose substituents are all equatorial, as in glucose, with the C6 hydroxymethyl group replaced by a carboxylate. The all-equatorial pattern leaves the C2 and C5 C-H bonds pointing at the aromatic panels.

Ka_ITC.locator: 1, row Glucuronic acid, column BPTL^2+/K a (M^-1) / ITC (row label in column  / Substrates)

candidates.name: glucose, the parent all-equatorial hexose
candidates.geometry: The same all-equatorial substitution pattern as glucuronic acid, with a neutral hydroxymethyl group at C6 instead of a carboxylate; the ring geometry and the orientation of every C-H bond are the same.

Ka_ITC.locator: 1, row Glucose, column BPTL^2+/K a (M^-1) / ITC (row label in column  / Substrates)

candidates.reason: 环上取代基取向与答案完全相同，但实测 Ka 只有 1700 M⁻¹，比 1 × 10⁴ 低一个数量级：同样的全平伏构型本身达不到目标档位。

candidates.name: methyl alpha-glucoside, glucose with an alpha-linked methyl group at the anomeric carbon
candidates.geometry: Glucose with the C1 hydroxyl replaced by an alpha-linked methoxy group, which turns the C1 C-H bond from axial to equatorial. The paper notes that the C1 C-H bond makes no C-H...pi contact, so this flip is the least consequential of the ones compared, but the alpha linkage still alters the orientation of that bond.

Ka_ITC.locator: 1, row Methyl α-glucoside, column BPTL^2+/K a (M^-1) / ITC (row label in column  / Substrates)

candidates.reason: α 端基连接改变 C1 C–H 取向，实测 Ka 为 252 M⁻¹，远低于目标。

candidates.name: galactose, the C4 epimer of glucose
candidates.geometry: Differs from glucose only at C4, where the hydroxyl is inverted from equatorial to axial; that inversion turns the C4 C-H bond away from the naphthalene panel it would otherwise contact.

Ka_ITC.locator: 1, row Galactose, column BPTL^2+/K a (M^-1) / ITC (row label in column  / Substrates)

candidates.reason: 只把 C4 羟基从平伏翻成直立，实测 Ka 就从葡萄糖的 1700 掉到 52 M⁻¹（33 倍），离目标最远。

paper_choice_locator: 标题即 "A Synthetic Lectin for Glucuronate"；Evaluation of Carbohydrate Binding in Water 一节称 "MPNT^2+·2Cl^- exhibited good selectivity toward carbohydrates with an all-equatorial substitution pattern. Glucuronate, glucose, and methyl β-glucoside are representative examples of this configuration and displayed the highest binding affinities"；Table 1 的 ITC 列给出四个候选的实测值

naive_cue.heuristic: 受体带两个正电荷，所以带负电的糖静电吸引最强
naive_cue.note: 本题的天真启发式恰好也选对，所以它的区分力有限（见 notes 第一条）。原文自己的反例是阴离子糖 Neu5Ac 完全测不到结合，说明电荷本身不足以决定；但该候选因无数值（N.D.）不能进入四选一。

scale.definition: 吡喃糖环上取代基的平伏/直立取向（判据为单个 C–H 或 C–O 键的朝向，环直径约 0.5 nm；本项为估算，原文未给出距离数值）

notes: **本卡的主要保留意见**：天真的静电启发式与正确答案一致（is_correct: true），所以这道题可能只考"认出带电的那个"而不是几何推理。是否保留、或改成只在中性糖之间比较（那样正确答案是葡萄糖，但"原文选定者"严格说是葡萄糖醛酸，不再满足题型族的原规则），须 L1 判定。
原文正文把半乳糖的亲和力写作 65 M⁻¹，而表 1 的 ITC 列为 52 ± 3、NMR 列为 68 ± 1，三处不一致；本卡用表 1 的 ITC 列，并把这一不一致交给 L1。该不一致不改变本题答案（三个取值都远低于 1 × 10⁴）。
表 1 的表头有两行，且行标签在第二列（第一列是条目编号）；本卡用两行表头路径与 row_column 指针定位，这是 2026-10-23 为此新增的解析能力。
表头写作 "BPTL^2+/K a (M^-1)"，而正文中的受体代号是 MPNT^2+；原文表头与正文代号不一致，须 L1 核对是否同一化合物。本卡的题干按正文使用 MPNT2+。
甘露糖与果糖在表中为 N.D.（测不到结合），Neu5Ac 亦为 N.D.；它们没有可解析的数值，不能作候选，但原文用它们论证"电荷不足以决定结合"。
候选集里刻意不含甲基 β-葡萄糖苷（575 M⁻¹），否则与甲基 α-葡萄糖苷构成"两个二选一"式的候选，格式检查会标记。
